# Introduction

Impacts of demographic and clinical factors on protein biomarkers at 
pre-treatment time point (W0). The low multicollinearity among all tested demographic 
and clinical factors (VIF < 2.5, Figure S13A) suggests that these factors are largely 
independent. Given the small sample size (n = 33 for the treatment success group), 
associations are explored using univariate linear models.

Figure S13C: It was reported in the literature that Mtb-infected female mice have higher IFNG and lower IL-10 compared to male mice. We tested if sex also affects IFNG and IL-10 levels in our human TB cohort.

# Load packages

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readxl)
library(DataExplorer)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(writexl)
library(broom)
library(ggpubr)
```

# Define file paths

```{r}
#| label: file-paths

input_file  <- "Input/Cytokines_cleaned_log10_Predict-TB.xlsx"
input_pet   <- "Input/PET.CT_long_SATVI.xlsx"
input_mtb   <- "Input/Mtb.lineage_SATVI_ID_Predict-TB_TS.xlsx"
output_main <- "Output/Figure_S13C"

dir.create(output_main, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Load data

```{r}
#| label: load-data

cytokine_data <- read_excel(input_file, sheet = 1) %>%
  filter(Comments == "success") %>%
  mutate(
    Condition   = ifelse(Condition == "TB", "Mtb_Ag", Condition),
    Visit       = paste0("W", Visit),
    Age         = as.numeric(Age),
    BMI         = as.numeric(BMI),
    Temp_0      = as.numeric(Temp_0),
    MGIT        = as.numeric(MGIT),
    Sex         = factor(Sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    Smoking     = ifelse(Smoking == "active smoker", "active_smoker_Yes", "active_smoker_No"),
    Previous_TB = ifelse(Previous_TB == "0 episode", "No", "Yes")
  )

str(cytokine_data)

pet_data <- read_excel(input_pet, sheet = 1) %>%
  filter(Comments == "success") %>%
  select(ID1, Visit, CAVTOT, TLG) %>%
  mutate(
    Visit  = paste0("W", Visit),
    CAVTOT = log10(1 + CAVTOT),   
    TLG    = log10(1 + TLG)
  )

head(pet_data)
dim(pet_data)

mtb_data <- read_excel(input_mtb, sheet = 1) %>%
  filter(Comments == "success") %>%
  select(ID1, main_lineage)

head(mtb_data)
dim(mtb_data)
```

# Merge cytokine, PET, and Mtb data sets

```{r}
#| label: merge-data

all_data <- cytokine_data %>%
  left_join(pet_data, by = c("ID1", "Visit")) %>%
  left_join(mtb_data, by = "ID1") %>%
  filter(Visit == "W0")

dim(all_data)
head(all_data)
```

# Define cytokine columns

```{r}
#| label: define-cytokines
cytokine_cols <- c(
 "BDNF", "CCL11", "Factor_VII", "ICAM_1",
  "IL_1_alpha", "IL_1_beta", "IL_10", "IL_12p40",
  "IL_12p70", "IL_18", "IL_1RA", "IL_3", "IL_4",
  "IL_6", "IL_7", "IL_8", "CCL2", "CCL3",
  "MMP_3", "TNF", "VEGF", "IFNG", "IL_2",
  "pan_IFNA", "IFNB"
)

cat(sprintf("Cytokines retained: %d\n", length(cytokine_cols)))
```

# Variance filtering by condition

```{r}
#| label: variance-filtering
#| message: true

conditions <- c("Null", "Mtb_Ag", "LPS", "IL1B")

variance_threshold <- 0.1

filtered_cytokines <- list()

for (condition in conditions) {
  
  condition_data <- all_data %>% filter(Condition == condition)
  
  cytokine_sds <- sapply(cytokine_cols, function(cyt) {
    sd(condition_data[[cyt]], na.rm = TRUE)
  })
  
  filtered_cytokines[[condition]] <- cytokine_cols[cytokine_sds > variance_threshold]
  
  excluded <- cytokine_cols[cytokine_sds <= variance_threshold]
  if (length(excluded) > 0) {
    message(sprintf(
      "Condition [%s] — excluding low-variance cytokines: %s",
      condition, paste(excluded, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }
}
```

# Univariate linear model fitting

```{r}
#| label: model-fitting
#| message: true
#| warning: false

categorical_vars <- c("Sex", "Smoking", "main_lineage", "Previous_TB")
numeric_vars     <- c("Age", "BMI", "Temp_0", "MGIT", "CAVTOT", "TLG")

model_results <- list()

for (condition in conditions) {
  
  condition_data <- all_data %>% filter(Condition == condition)
  
  # Validate categorical predictors (require ≥ 2 observed levels)
  valid_categorical_vars <- categorical_vars[sapply(categorical_vars, function(var) {
    n_lev <- n_distinct(condition_data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
    if (n_lev < 2) {
      message(sprintf(
        "Condition [%s] — excluding categorical var '%s': only %d level(s) observed.",
        condition, var, n_lev
      ))
    }
    n_lev >= 2
  })]
  
  # Validate numeric predictors (require ≥ 2 unique non-NA values) 
  valid_numeric_vars <- numeric_vars[sapply(numeric_vars, function(var) {
    n_uniq <- n_distinct(condition_data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
    if (n_uniq < 2) {
      message(sprintf(
        "Condition [%s] — excluding numeric var '%s': insufficient variability.",
        condition, var
      ))
    }
    n_uniq >= 2
  })]
  
  valid_predictors <- c(valid_numeric_vars, valid_categorical_vars)
  
  if (length(valid_predictors) == 0) {
    message(sprintf("Condition [%s] — no valid predictors; skipping.", condition))
    next
  }
  
  # Standardise numeric predictors
  condition_data <- condition_data %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(valid_numeric_vars), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x))))
  
  # Get cytokines passing variance filter for this condition
  valid_cytokines <- filtered_cytokines[[condition]]
  
  if (length(valid_cytokines) == 0) {
    message(sprintf("Condition [%s] — no cytokines pass variance filter; skipping.", condition))
    next
  }
  
  # Standardise cytokines
  condition_data <- condition_data %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(valid_cytokines), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x))))
  
  # Fit one univariate model per cytokine × predictor pair
  for (cytokine in valid_cytokines) {
    for (predictor in valid_predictors) {
      
      formula <- as.formula(paste(cytokine, "~", predictor))
      
      tryCatch({
        model      <- lm(formula, data = condition_data)
        tidy_model <- broom::tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE)
        
        tidy_model$Cytokine  <- cytokine
        tidy_model$Condition <- condition
        
        model_results[[paste(condition, cytokine, predictor, sep = "_")]] <- tidy_model
        
      }, error = function(e) {
        message(sprintf(
          "Model error — condition: %s | cytokine: %s | predictor: %s\n  %s",
          condition, cytokine, predictor, e$message
        ))
      })
    }
  }
}

# Combine all results and apply FDR correction within each condition
results_df <- bind_rows(model_results) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%                         
  mutate(p.adjusted = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup()

cat(sprintf("Total model terms (excluding intercepts): %d\n", nrow(results_df)))
```

# Filter significant results and tidy labels

```{r}
#| label: filter-significant

significant_df <- results_df %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE               ~ ""
    ),
    term = case_when(
      term == "SexMale"               ~ "Sex_Male",
      term == "Previous_TBYes"        ~ "Previous_TB_Yes",
      term == "main_lineagelineage4"  ~ "lineage4",
      term == "Smokingactive_smoker_Yes" ~ "active_smoker_Yes",
      term == "Temp_0"                ~ "Temperature",
      term == "CAVTOT"                ~ "total cavity volume",
      term == "TLG"                   ~ "total lesion glycolysis volume",
      TRUE                            ~ term
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Condition, Cytokine, term)

# Ordered factor levels
significant_df$Condition <- factor(
  significant_df$Condition,
  levels = c("Null", "Mtb_Ag", "LPS", "IL1B")
)

predictor_order <- c(
  "Age", "Sex_Male", "BMI", "Temperature",
  "active_smoker_Yes", "MGIT", "lineage4", "Previous_TB_Yes",
  "total cavity volume", "total lesion glycolysis volume"
)

significant_df$term <- factor(significant_df$term, levels = predictor_order)

cat(sprintf("Significant associations (p < 0.05): %d\n", nrow(significant_df)))
```

# Heatmap plot

```{r}
#| label: heatmap-plot
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 10

heatmap_plot <- ggplot(significant_df, aes(x = term, y = Cytokine, fill = estimate)) +
  geom_tile(color = "#999999") +
  geom_text(aes(label = significance), color = "black", size = 4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low      = "blue",
    mid      = "white",
    high     = "red",
    midpoint = 0,
    na.value = "white",
    name     = "Standardized\nEffect Size"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Condition, nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    title    = "Correlations of demographic and clinical predictors with W0 cytokine levels (log10)",
    subtitle = "P value without FDR corrections: * < 0.05  ** < 0.01  *** < 0.001",
    x        = "Predictor",
    y        = "Protein biomarker (log10 pg/mL)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.spacing.x  = unit(0.05, "lines"),
    panel.border     = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "lightgrey", color = "black")
  )

print(heatmap_plot)
```

# Save outputs

```{r}
#| label: save-outputs

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_main, "Figure_5E_heatmap.pdf"),
  plot     = heatmap_plot,
  width    = 14,
  height   = 10
)

write_xlsx(
  list(
    "All_results"          = results_df,
    "Significant_FDR_0.05" = significant_df
  ),
  path = file.path(output_main, "Figure_5E_model_results.xlsx")
)

cat("Outputs saved to:", output_main, "\n")
```
Check how sex affects Null_IFNG at W0
```{r}
#| label: plot-ifng-sex
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 6

# Extract the data
ifng_null <- all_data %>%
  filter(Condition == "Null") %>%
  select(ID1, Sex, IFNG) %>%
  drop_na(Sex, IFNG)

ifng_plot <- ggplot(ifng_null, aes(x = Sex, y = IFNG, fill = Sex)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_compare_means(
    method  = "wilcox.test",
    label   = "p.format",
    comparisons = list(c("Female", "Male"))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Female" = "#E76BF3", "Male" = "#00B0F6")) +
  labs(
    title    = "Null_IFNG at W0",
    subtitle = "Wilcoxon test",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Null_IFNG (log10 pg/mL)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(ifng_plot)

# Save the plot
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_main, "Null_IFNG_Sex.pdf"),
  plot     = ifng_plot,
  width    = 4.5,
  height   = 4.5
)
```
